questions.subskill: Interpreting a linear equation in two variables
questions.stem: A store sells birdseed in 4-pound bags and 3-pound bags. The equation 4x + 3y = 60 represents a shipment of x four-pound bags and y three-pound bags that weighs 60 pounds in all. If the shipment contains 6 four-pound bags, how many three-pound bags does it contain?

questions.subskill: Solving a linear system for an expression
questions.stem:
3x + 2y = 19
x − y = 3
If (x, y) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of x + y ?

questions.subskill: Writing a linear inequality from a context
questions.stem: A delivery van can safely carry at most 1,200 kilograms. The driver weighs 80 kilograms, and each box the van carries weighs 35 kilograms. Which inequality represents the possible numbers of boxes, n, the van can safely carry with the driver aboard?

questions.subskill: Expanding and combining polynomial expressions
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to (2x − 3)² − (x + 1)² ?

questions.subskill: Arc length with a radian measure
questions.stem: In a circle with radius 15 centimeters, a central angle measures 4π/5 radians. The length of the arc intercepted by the angle is kπ centimeters. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Remainder of a polynomial from its division form
questions.stem: For a polynomial p, p(x) = (x − 2)q(x) + 5 for all values of x, where q is a polynomial. Which of the following must be true?

questions.subskill: Perfect-square trinomial
questions.stem: The expression 4x² + bx + 9, where b is a positive constant, can be written as (mx + n)² for some constants m and n. What is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Percent of a percent
questions.stem: In a survey of 240 students, 35% said they bike to school. Of the students who bike to school, 25% said they ride more than 3 miles each way. How many of the surveyed students ride more than 3 miles each way?

questions.subskill: Unit rate in a proportion
questions.stem: A car travels 150 miles on 6 gallons of gas. At this rate, how many gallons of gas does the car need to travel 425 miles?

questions.subskill: Same-side interior angles with algebra
questions.stem: Lines m and n are parallel, and line t crosses both of them. On the same side of t and between m and n, one angle measures (2x + 15)° and the other measures (4x + 45)°. What is the measure of the smaller of these two angles?

questions.subskill: Intersection of two lines
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = 4x − 10 and y = −x + 5 intersect at the point (a, b). What is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Solving a linear equation in one variable
questions.stem:
5(t − 3) + 2 = 3t + 9
What value of t satisfies the equation above?

questions.subskill: Linear equation with infinitely many solutions
questions.stem: In the equation 3(2x − 1) = 6x + k, k is a constant. For what value of k does the equation have infinitely many solutions?

questions.subskill: System of linear equations in context
questions.stem: At a café, 3 muffins and 2 coffees cost $14.50, and 2 muffins and 3 coffees cost $15.50. Each muffin has the same price, and each coffee has the same price. What is the price of one coffee?

questions.subskill: Rewriting exponential expressions with a common base
questions.stem: Which expression is equivalent to 9^(x/2) for all real values of x ?

questions.subskill: Intersection of a line and a parabola
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = x² − 3x and y = x + 5 intersect at two points. What is the greatest x-coordinate of these points?

questions.subskill: Simplifying a rational expression
questions.stem: For x ≠ 1, which of the following is equivalent to (x + 5)/(x − 1) − 6/(x − 1) ?

questions.subskill: Conclusions from a randomized experiment
questions.stem: Researchers selected 300 adults at random from a city's residents. They randomly assigned 150 of them to walk 30 minutes a day and the other 150 to keep their usual routines. After 12 weeks, the walking group had lower average blood pressure. Which conclusion is best supported by the study?

choices.A: Walking 30 minutes a day causes lower blood pressure for all adults in every city.
choices.B: There is an association between walking and blood pressure, but no evidence that walking caused the difference.
choices.C: Walking 30 minutes a day likely causes lower blood pressure for adults in the city.
choices.D: Walking 30 minutes a day causes lower blood pressure only for the 150 adults who walked.

questions.subskill: Converting a rate between units
questions.stem: A runner covers 1,500 meters in 6 minutes. At this rate, what is the runner's speed in kilometers per hour?

questions.subskill: Rectangle from its diagonal and one side
questions.stem: A rectangle has a diagonal of length 13 inches and one side of length 5 inches. What is the area of the rectangle, in square inches?

questions.subskill: Matching coefficients of a product
questions.stem:
(ax + 3)(bx + 7) = 15x² + cx + 21
In the equation above, a, b and c are constants, the equation is true for all values of x, and a + b = 8. What is the greatest possible value of c ?

questions.subskill: Equation of a circle with an unknown constant
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of x² + y² + 8x − 6y = k is a circle with radius 6. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Right-triangle trigonometry with a given ratio
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, tan A = 5/12 and AB = 26. What is the length of BC ?

questions.subskill: Solutions of a linear inequality
questions.stem: Which of the following values of x is a solution to the inequality 3 − 2x > 11 ?

questions.subskill: System of linear inequalities in context
questions.stem: Each week Maya runs r miles and bikes b miles. Running burns 110 calories per mile, and biking burns 40 calories per mile. She wants to burn at least 2,000 calories while covering no more than 30 miles in all. Which of the following choices of (r, b) meets both goals?

questions.subskill: Interpreting an exponential growth factor
questions.stem: The population of a town t years after 2020 is modeled by P(t) = 8,000(1.05)^(t/2). Which statement best describes how the population changes according to the model?

questions.subskill: Solving a rational equation
questions.stem:
4/(x − 2) = 2/(x − 5)
What value of x satisfies the equation above?
